describes: TEMPLATE for a daily CSV downloaded from Cloud Billing > Reports (grouped by SKU, daily). Column names, date format and the timezone of the days are ASSUMED.

unverified: every column name (date, service_description, sku_description, usage_amount, usage_unit, cost, currency)
timezone of the report days (NOT assumed: naive dates are rejected until --declared-timezone is given)
SKU description wording and usage unit
provenance.notes: Prefer gemini_billing_export_csv (documented schema). Use this template only if the BigQuery export is unavailable; adapt the column names to the real header and pass --declared-timezone with the timezone shown by the Reports page.

timestamps.note: Day timezone unknown: must be declared by the caller.
